**What it is:** Executive training for the C-suite: real business cases, boardroom challenges and spaced-repetition drills. Earn C-Suite Coach Institute certificates.
**Live:** https://csuite-coach.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/csuitecoach · **Layout:** JavaScript pages + tools/deploy.py (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/csuitecoach/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- Edit the **project source in this folder**; GitHub only holds the built output (`tools/deploy.py` builds
  `theme/assets/app.js`/`app.css` from `web/`). Never edit `tools/.anvil-repo`.
- **New page**: `web/pages/<name>.html` with `UI.page('<name>', {title, auth, nav}, mount)`. Shared engines: `web/pages/_*.html`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code/<Module>.py`; call it from a page with `UI.api('name', {...})`.
- **New table/column**: `TABLES` in `tools/sync_to_anvil.py` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert after deploy).
- **Header, footer, tab bar**: `web/app.js`. Shared helpers: `web/core.js` (`window.UI`). Tokens + components: `web/core.css`.
- **Check**: `python -I tools/check.py --ui` → ALL CHECKS PASSED. Look: `tools/preview/devserver.py` + `tools/preview/shots.py`.
- **Deploy**: `python tools/deploy.py` (dry run), then `python tools/deploy.py --push "Message"`.
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py csuitecoach` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`tools/sync_to_anvil.py` TABLES)

- **users**: display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, xp:num, streak:num, last_study:date, job_title:str, honour_roll:bool · used in Admin, DemoData
- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **card_state**: user→users, item:str, module:str, box:num, due:date, reviews:num, lapses:num, last:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning
- **module_progress**: user→users, module:str, read_at:dt, challenge_score:num, completed_at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Curriculum, DemoData, Learning
- **attempts**: user→users, challenge:str, module:str, answer:str, points:obj, score:num, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Learning
- **exams**: user→users, track:str, started:dt, finished:dt, card_score:num, scenario_score:num, passed:bool, detail:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Exams
- **credentials**: user→users, track:str, code:str, holder:str, issued:dt, score:num, revoked:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Credentials, Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning

## Tools

- `tools/check.py`: Checks before deploying. Run from anywhere:
- `tools/deploy.py`: Deploy the project to Anvil through its GitHub repo (REPO in tools/sync_to_anvil.py).
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/sync_to_anvil.py`: Write this project into the Anvil app's git checkout (the repo Anvil syncs with GitHub).
